categories.name: Facial Contour
categories.desc_th: ยกกระชับและปรับสัดส่วนใบหน้า ทั้งเครื่องมือยกกระชับและงานฉีด คุณหมอวางแผนทีละจุดตามโครงหน้า ให้ผลลัพธ์ยังเป็นตัวคุณ
categories.desc_en: Lifting and facial balancing with energy devices and injectables, planned point by point around your bone structure so you still look like you.

categories.name: Derma Longevity

categories.desc_en: Care that reaches the deeper layers, where collagen, elastin and the ECM hold your skin up, so it stays healthy for longer.

categories.name: Scar Revision & Dermatosurgery

categories.desc_en: Treatment for acne scars and other scars, plus keloid and minor skin surgery by our doctors, with the method chosen for each type of scar.

categories.name: Hair & Scalp Longevity

categories.desc_en: Care for hair loss and thinning hair that starts with a scalp check and the cause, then a plan made for you.

categories.desc_en: Targeted body contouring that works with your natural shape.

categories.name: Longevity Wellness
